{{Top|leg}}
The '''Tyrossum''' was a creature native to [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. The jawbone of one would be used during [[Rock Council]] meetings to signify who had the right to speak during the council. If someone else wanted to put a word in, they had to fight who ever had it in order to ascertain the right.
